reason: Plan Phase 5, closed. The shade is a dark copy of the blade sprite, clipped by a scissor mask from the cut to the tip, that draws the bar's own live atlas window: the tier's frame, so the worn notches and the raised tail run on past the cut at orange and red and the bottom edge is straight at yellow and above, exactly like the kept part. The window is published through the game's mTextureRect setter (main+0xa4fb58) every frame, because the drawn quad's UVs are a cache: the draw slot main+0xa4fc9c calls main+0xa4feb4, which reads +0x10c..+0x118 and the colours at +0xa4 only when (global+0x98 & (node+0xc0 >> 24) & 7) is set and clears those bits after, and the setter is the only path to that mark (it stores +0x10c, calls slot 0x28 when +0x108 & 0x30, and tail-calls vtable slot 0x50, main+0xa4fc68, the writer of bits 24..26). The raw writes r59, r60 and r61 used mark nothing, which is why all three drew the yellow frame at every tier. Accepted on Eden 2026-11-01 at the red tier (crop sha256 bb02addc7e2fe678977f453a08af0fcffdf7d6d68fc8e708dfc62329d16a1fdb, installed NRO 51aa1ca0811fa8c509f28069410eaa843ea11fc5c71926edadebd39d4cafe416). r61 (52be4a7) is withdrawn: packaged, never run, do not ship; its squeeze premise, and r58's, is refuted. r63 is the consolidation of accepted r62: the fill line, the 35-word gauge row facts line, the copy's texture/flags/sampler read-backs, the link snapshot, the walker and instance counters, the log clock and the queue and hot-hook reads behind them are deleted, and one line per lifecycle event is kept. 6 tree nodes, 7-word object array, (6 << 4) | 8 = 104 bytes = 13 records, the walk emits exactly 13; 23 host fixtures pass and verify PASSED with 33 signature windows. r63 has not been run: the promotion is approved on static validation, and the drawing is accepted r62's.
runtime_test: Ran on Eden on 2026-11-02 (log work/shared/runs/eden-2026-11-02.txt, installed NRO matches): MSG r63 scissor mask inserted at 130.479939 and 965.056722 with entries=7 and records=13, inserted mask's links lost at 475.835413 and 2058.468105, no guest exception, and a host SIGSEGV 0.49 s after ForceStop. There is no user report on its picture. The accepted runtime evidence is accepted r62's Eden run of 2026-11-01: installed NRO 51aa1ca0811fa8c509f28069410eaa843ea11fc5c71926edadebd39d4cafe416, the packaged payload; the crop work/modern-sharpness-gauge/visual/r62/r62-red-1.png (sha256 bb02addc7e2fe678977f453a08af0fcffdf7d6d68fc8e708dfc62329d16a1fdb) shows the dark part with the notched bottom edge and the raised tail at the red tier, its kept part red (108,25,14); the retained Eden log's 578 fill lines all read shade_tex= equal to tex=, both 0.0 280.0 88.0 304.0, with one insertion at entries=7 records=13 and no panic in the window (runs/r62-eden-2026-11-01.msg-lines.txt sha256 19b089cc0973b6032257963dd030943ca1b6097ef8cdcb87481abe492c15d1f5). r63's bytes ship on static validation, with the user's explicit choice to promote without a run. r61 was never run and is withdrawn. Orange tier, Ryujinx and Switch hardware unconfirmed.

limitations: the clip mask's bit 17 is the transform gate in main+0xa4964c / main+0xa4969c, and the r57 copy state lines show the matrix tail 0.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 until the tree was dirtied: what the shade looks like once the clip is composed is unproven until r59 runs. The copy's first mat= line after the insertion and the fill line's shade_box= are the instruments
bar_sampler= and dim_sampler= are reads of the low nibble of +0x108: equal numbers prove the copy was given the bar's style byte, not that the two halves filter identically on screen
r4 has no runtime test; its lines, the 320-sample budget and the absence of any drawing change are static results.
r2 was built and never run; r3 was run once on Eden and is recorded.
r14 was run once on Eden and failed as reported: the gauge was clipped away from the insertion and the game crashed at the quest end. Its log is the evidence, and the insertion is removed in r15.

r15 was run once on Eden and drew the gauge normally for 740 seconds with no exception; its facts line printed tree_nodes 3 against 4 objects, and its object-list fields were read from the wrong object (the controller's owner field), which is what r16 fixes.

r16 changes nothing on screen: it reads game memory and logs. No drawing, no gauge change, and no cleanup claim (the root-destructor hook fired zero times in the three sessions that logged it). Its Eden run ended in Eden's own shutdown records (maxwell_3d Critical asserts, ForceStop, host SIGSEGV) with zero guest exceptions.
the game's destructor is assumed to free the map block r17 publishes through the cGUIInstance DTI's MT allocator; that free has not been observed, and r17 frees the old 4-word block itself
The per-weapon tier tables live in RomFS weapon data and are not read in this workspace: no weapon data file is extracted here.
The gauge itself is not part of r4.

r25 has not been run. r24's run drew the gauge from the quest start and lost it at an area change, where a mask kept clipping after its links broke; the disable-on-loss path has no runtime evidence, and a mask inserted into a second area's row has never been observed (r24's log ends 12 s after the transition, gauge HUD absent)
r40 has not been run. Its two defaults are the endpoints the r39 log shows applied (right edge 129 px at 0% and 201 px at 100%), read from the tester's run, not from an r40 run.
r42 has not been run. Its fill comes from the player fields Phase 1 verified and the r41 run's accepted geometry; the per-frame fill has not been seen on screen.
r43 has not been run. 128 px at 0% is proven by the r42 log (the tester dragged the start there); 200 px at 100% is the tester's measurement, and that run's box ended at 201.
The thread that runs the draw walker at main+0xa494a0 is unproven, and the run did not change that: no bl site, stored word or DTI property in main names that entry.

The MT `color` word's byte order is unproven, so the dim blade's alpha byte position is an inference. The facts line now prints the bar's four corner colours, so a run pins it next to the colour on screen.

The r44 build is at build/modern-sharpness-gauge/candidates/r44/, runtime UNCHANGED; r45 through r52 are superseded, r52 with its copy seen on screen; r53 is a new candidate and carries no distribution approval.
the bar's eff=0 0 0 0 in the r53, r55, r56 and r57 runs, where accepted r44 logged a non-zero eff: accepted r44 measured the bar at its own prepaint, these runs read it at the mask's enter
the coloured part keeps the glow's halo (Txt_sharpefx at PosX 6, PosY -6, 88x32, alpha 120) and the dark part has none: the Phase 5 design question, asked and left open
the worn blade at the orange tier: the accepted crop is the red tier and the retained Eden log window keeps no orange band line, so orange rides the same setter path without being seen
a full session: one quest, one insertion, two scene teardowns, 578 fill lines; Ryujinx and Switch hardware unconfirmed

evidence.static_summary: r63: pinned toolchain build; 23 host fixtures passed; verify.py PASSED with 33 NSO signature windows, a unique hook window, the exact export set, resolved imports only, no MSR in the disassembly, no DT_TEXTREL and a one-file payload. r63 is accepted r62 with the run instruments removed: the fill line, the 35-word gauge row facts line, the copy's texture-object/flags/sampler read-backs, the link snapshot, the walker and instance counters and the log clock, plus the queue and hot-hook reads behind them. The contract that makes the shade draw the worn tier frame is untouched: write_shade publishes the bar's own live four floats through the mTextureRect setter (main+0xa4fb58), which stores +0x10c, calls slot 0x28 when +0x108 & 0x30, and tail-calls vtable slot 0x50 (main+0xa4fc68), the writer of the +0xc0 bits 24..26 that the draw slot main+0xa4fc9c's builder main+0xa4feb4 consumes and clears. 6 tree nodes, 7-word object array, (6 << 4) | 8 = 104 bytes = 13 records, and the walk emits exactly 13. See EVIDENCE.json, DEVELOPMENT.md and work/modern-sharpness-gauge/PHASE5_RESEARCH.md.
evidence.manual_summary: The accepted r44 cut is one Eden run of 2026-10-30, the installed NRO matching the packaged payload. r45 ran 2026-10-31 as FROZEN_GAME. r46 ran clean with no copy, r47, r48 and r50 logged the copy build and the draw, r51 added the queue, r54 added the mask enter and ran with the copy frozen, r55 logged the link-lost teardown and r56 proved the map overflow. r57 was run on Eden 2026-10-31 and rejected on screen. r59 was accepted on Eden 2026-11-01 for the shade's placement, colour, transform and sampler. r60 ran the same day and was rejected with the dark part unchanged at orange and red. r61 was packaged, never run, withdrawn. r62 published the copy's atlas window through the native setter and is accepted on Eden 2026-11-01: the crop of the red tier shows the worn blade. r63 is that drawing with the run instruments deleted, released on static validation with no run of its own. Ryujinx and Switch hardware unconfirmed.
